name: Himitsu na Futari
source:
In order to inherit an enormous amount of money…I have to marry my brother?!

Even as you fight with your emotions, you must choose the path you will take. Will you choose the inherited money? Your dreams as a designer? Or, will you pursue the love you have hidden away for all these years?

…It’s our secret.

[From [url=http://www.englishotomegames.net/post/77338801635/its-our-secret-2-release-dates]English Otome Games[/url]]
